# Reinvention Works

> Reinvention Works provides peer-led education for adults rebuilding identity after disability, illness, or a health disruption, and for the organizations that support them. It is education, not therapy, medical care, or crisis support. Founder and Lead Facilitator: Shay Edmonds.

## Programs
- [Programs](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/programs/): The Reinvention Reset System. Your First Move (free), the 3-Day Reinvention Reset, Graduate Community, and Reinvention Coaching Calls (coming soon).

## For organizations
- [For Organizations](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/organizations/): How healthcare providers, vocational rehabilitation and independent living teams, and employers can make Reinvention Works available as a resource.

## About
- [About Shay Edmonds](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/about/): The founder's story and the philosophy behind Reinvention Works.
- [Speaking and Training](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/speaking/): Keynotes, workshops, and organizational training.
- [The Book](https://reinvention-works-website.netlify.app/book/): Stop the Self-Sabotage: From Broken to Unfinished.
